summary.dese_building_directory_source: Missouri DESE School Directory Building List
summary.dese_building_directory_note: DESE says School Directory data are refreshed weekly. This cache may be replaced with a Building List export; when absent, the builder seeds a conservative school-code cache from the public 2025 MEDE school-level MAP rows.
summary.map_2025_note: MAP assessment data uses tested-student denominators; subgroup n_size values are not full-school enrollment counts.
summary.black_student_history_caveat: Uses annual NCES CCD/EDGE school-site enrolled-student race records when Black count and a usable denominator are present; private schools are unavailable.
summary.attendance_standard_history_source_label: Missouri DESE MCDS Building Proportional Attendance Rate
summary.attendance_standard_history_caveat: Uses reviewed school-level rows with normalized rates for students meeting the 90% attendance standard; count bars require source numerator and denominator fields.
